item.title: When the bombs fell on Caracas | Under the Shadow S2E5
item.description: The United States has painted its January 3 invasion of Venezuela as a surgical operation. But for those on the ground it was a disaster. The US killed more than 100 people. It hit civilian targets and left terror and destruction in its wake. This is episode 5 of Under the Shadow, Season 2.

item.title: Class action granted: Angola prisoners head to trial over slave labor
item.description: A US District Court has certified a class action for incarcerated men at Angola Prison who are forced to perform punitive farm labor under extreme, unconstitutional conditions.

item.title: ‘My home is making me sick’: East Palestine residents abandoned after train derailment
item.description: “You can never describe in words the feeling of what Norfolk Southern has taken away from not only me, but the residents and the community members that have been affected by this train derailment.”

item.title: Poisoned, exploited, abandoned: East Palestine, OH, three years later
item.description: Opportunistic politicians, sensationalist media outlets, class action attorneys—residents affected by the 2023 Norfolk Southern train derailment and chemical disaster have been exploited by everyone and helped by hardly anyone.

item.title: How the destruction of Gaza’s medical system became a weapon of war
item.description: Gaza’s healthcare collapse is killing children right now, doctors warn.

item.title: Dr. Wolff explains the secret ingredient to economic fascism
item.description: Renowned economist Dr. Richard Wolff examines how oil functions not just as a resource but as a tool of political control and imperial power, as illustrated by recent US aggression in Venezuela.

item.title: Under Putin’s Thumb: War, Repression, and Resistance
item.description: Ksenia Kagarlitskaya and Ilya Budraitskis explain the nature and evolution of Putin’s regime, the plight of its political prisoners, and the prospects for antiwar resistance and class struggle.

item.title: Rubio confirms end of New START, sparking calls for nuclear talks with Russia, China

item.title: Inside Syria’s women-led revolution
item.description: TRNN was granted rare access to a YPJ commander at a hidden base in northeast Syria, offering a ground-level view of a women’s revolution as Rojava was preparing for war.
